when_edited: after the stage wrote PROTOCOL.json and its per-unit results
edit_scope: report rendering only: the direction-preserved/reversed verdict block and the count of reversals whose magnitude stays below the practical scale
effect_on_numbers: no metric, interval, delta or replay computation was touched; the unit JSONs and the aggregate CSVs came from the same frozen per-unit records (all_replay_pass=true, max replay diff 4.4e-16)
disclosure: the recorded protocol hash is the version that produced the per-unit results; the current file differs only in report rendering. The protocol was deliberately NOT rewritten so the change stays visible.
how_to_recheck: re-run the stage with --resume; it reads the frozen per-unit records, skips the completed units, and regenerates the aggregate CSVs from them
